author: PBS Space Time
description:
Black holes don't just swallow matter—they may be responsible for shutting down star formation across some of the largest galaxies in the universe. Discover how supermassive black holes unleash powerful quasars that disrupt their galaxies' gas supplies, leaving behind enormous collections of stars that astronomers call "red and dead."
